title: Horned Angel Portal
description: A blue-skinned, horned angel with large blue and gold wings stands powerfully in the center, holding a glowing orb. He wears a beige trench coat over a red vest with a golden halo above his head, surrounded by floating arcane symbols and blue ethereal creatures.
prompt: A majestic blue-skinned horned male angel with massive blue and gold feathered wings, wearing an open beige trench coat over a red vest and boots, stands in an ancient stone temple. He holds a glowing blue orb in one hand while a golden halo floats above his head. Behind him is a large arched stone portal revealing a mystical blue forest with glowing trees and light rays. Floating golden runes and blue spirit creatures swirl around him in a dramatic, ethereal atmosphere.
